scope: One exact validation request only; no cross-run cache, old-global replacement or skipped scientific gate.
before: Three independent historical validations constructed separate exact path resolvers. Every constructor rehashed all mapped raw files; repeated logical reads also rehashed an already checked file.
proposed_after: Retain exact verified immutable resolver and parsed-metadata subproofs only within one validation session. Collect every actually read canonical path, complete device/inode/owner/mode/size/mtime/ctime identity and byte digest. Stream-hash every unique current actual file again before accepting any reused subproof, including every Python source and every declared Git source identity. Reject changed bytes even if size and timestamps were restored; reject any changed file identity or stat field. Reuse only duplicate parsing and duplicate logical aliases after exact complete revalidation.
required_independent_fixtures: Every unique actual raw and source file still receives a complete initial and final byte hash.
A changed byte with restored size and modification time is refused.
A changed inode, owner, mode, device, size, modification time or change time is refused.
Changed resolver declarations, Git roots, commits, path aliases and referenced manifests are refused.
No reuse across requests, source closures or parent/child challenge identities.
All gates and output meaning match the unchanged historical consumer on the same frozen inputs.
helper_union_requirement: The shared dependency must be staged whenever any current consumer declares it. The current direct common guard stages its strict historical reader at 28 files. A future optional reuse helper would require an explicit reviewed 29-file protocol and both-feature, either-feature and neither-feature staging checks. The current frozen direct-profile roster does not yet declare this new strict reader and must receive a separate reviewed dependency update before using the future combined source.
